payload.title: launcher model route: project modelRoles and thinking suffix unproven
payload.body: The omp-agent launcher keeps an @role in the definition's model list only when 'omp config get modelRoles' (the global config, measured on omp 18.4.9 to ignore a project-level override) lists it. A role mapped only in a project's settings is therefore dropped and omp chooses its own model. Also unmeasured: whether --model @role carries the role value's :thinking suffix as a dispatched spawn does (no API credentials here to observe it).
